scripts.text: You're pretty bright~ seeing that you got all 3 correct. Now do you understand about ^006400Memorial Dungeon^000000?
scripts.translation: 你真聰明～三道題都答對了。現在你瞭解記憶地下城了嗎？ ^006400^000000

scripts.text: If you ever want to go over things about ^006400Memorial Dungeon^000000, come talk to me any time.
scripts.translation: 以後想複習記憶地下城相關內容，隨時來找我。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: Now, off you go to the ^0000FFMap Expert^000000!
You look like you have potential... you should try again.
scripts.translation: 你看起來很有潛力...再試一次吧。

scripts.text: It's easy to understand since it's coming from an expert like me. Now it's quiz time. You have to get all the answers correct to pass. Are you ready?
scripts.translation: 由我這位專家來講解，內容應該很好理解。現在開始測驗，全部答對才能通過。準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: Giving up is lame. If you change your mind, come talk to me.
scripts.translation: 放棄可不太體面。改變主意的話，再來找我聊聊。

scripts.text: Giving up without even trying is lame. If you change your mind, come talk to me.
scripts.translation: 還沒試就放棄可不太體面。改變主意的話，再來找我聊聊。

scripts.text: If you want to learn anything from me, talk to the ^006400Battleground Master^000000 first and get acknowledged by him.
scripts.translation: 想向我請教的話，先去找戰場大師並獲得他的認可。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: The ^006400Memorial Dungeon^000000is not a dungeon that is open to everyone. It only opens to ^0000FFYou and your Party Members^000000.
scripts.translation: 記憶地下城並非對所有人開放，只有你和隊伍成員才能進入。 ^006400^000000^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Therefore, in order to enter ^006400Memorial Dungeon^000000, the Party Leader must apply to enter. Since you enter in the order you apply, you must be on stand-by to enter.
scripts.translation: 進入記憶地下城前，必須由隊長提出申請。入場順序按申請先後排列，所以申請後要在一旁等候。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: Also, after you explore Memorial Dungeon, you cannot re-enter the same ^006400Memorial Dungeon^000000 for a certain period of time.
scripts.translation: 另外，完成一次記憶地下城後，需要等待一段時間才能再次進入同一個記憶地下城。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: Many ^006400Memorial Dungeon^000000s exist, but we will give you hints to help you find Memorial Dungeon in the world of Midgard.
scripts.translation: 米德加爾特有許多記憶地下城。我們會給你一些線索，告訴你該去哪裡找。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: First, go to ^8B4513Alberta^000000 and find ^006400Captain Jansen^000000.
He will give you information about the really huge and tall dungeon known as ^006400Endless Tower^000000.
scripts.translation: 長。他會告訴你那座高聳巨大的迷宮——無盡之塔的相關情報。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: Second, go to the ^8B4513Orc Map^000000 where all the orcs live and find the ^006400Insane Scientist^000000.
You might be able to get some information about a dungeon that has to do with ^006400Orc's Memory^000000.
scripts.translation: 0000。他或許能提供與獸人記憶有關的地下城情報。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: Third and last, seek out the place where you can become a monk, which is the ^8B4513Capitolina Monastery^000000 and seek out ^006400Detective Patrick^000000.
scripts.translation: 最後，前往武僧修行之地聖卡波利納修道院，尋找偵探帕特里克。 ^8B4513^000000^006400^000000

scripts.text: He will be able to give you information about the dungeon with the ^006400Sealed Baphomet^000000+.
scripts.translation: 他會告訴你封印著巴風特的地下城的情報+。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: Of course there are other locations for Memorial Dungeon but it's best to start where you can find it easily.
scripts.translation: 當然，記憶地下城還有其他地點，不過最好先從容易找到的地方開始

scripts.text: As you continue to go on your adventures you will be able to find them more easily.
scripts.translation: 。隨著冒險經驗增加，你會越來越容易發現它們。

scripts.text: Seeing that you came to me, I assume you have some questions about ^006400MAP^000000s?
scripts.translation: 你特地來找我，想必是想了解地圖吧？ ^006400^000000

scripts.text: If you end up in those areas while you're adventuring, be sure to tell me all about it!
scripts.translation: 冒險時要是去了那些地方，記得回來告訴我！現在你已經通

scripts.text: And now, since you've passed all the Expert's quizzes, go on and talk to ^006400Tutorial Goal^000000.
scripts.translation: 過了所有專家的測驗，去找教學目標吧。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: If you have any more questions, come find me.
scripts.translation: 還有問題的話，隨時來找我。

scripts.text: I have been researching and studying ^006400MAP^000000s for 16 years and so now I am the ^006400MAP^000000 Expert!
Since you've sought me out, it seems you've passed ^006400Memorial Dungeon Expert^000000's quiz.
scripts.translation: ！既然你來找我，看來已經通過記憶地下城專家的測驗了。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: As you already know, if you pass all the Experts' quiz you'll get a prize.
scripts.translation: 你應該已經知道，通過所有專家的測驗就能獲得獎勵。

scripts.text: As the last Expert, I will try to explain everything about ^006400MAP^000000s to make it easy on you. Ready to start?
scripts.translation: 作為最後一位專家，我會盡量把地圖相關內容講得簡單易懂。準備好了嗎？ ^006400^000000

scripts.translation: 我是最後一位專家！別放棄！準備好後再來找我！

scripts.text: A ^006400MAP^000000 shows you things that is much needed for travelling around the world; such as the lay of the land, major towns and fields and such. It's a very important tool!
scripts.translation: 地圖會顯示你在世界各地旅行時需要的資訊，例如地形、主要城鎮和原野等，是非常重要的工具！ ^006400^000000

scripts.text: Because of this, it's more important than everything else that you know about ^006400MAP^000000s.
scripts.translation: 正因如此，瞭解地圖比其他事情都重要。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: The map can be accessed by clicking on the button that says ^006400MAP^000000 on the upper left side of your screen.
scripts.translation: 點選螢幕左上角標有地圖的按鈕，就能開啟地圖。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: When you click on the ^006400MAP^000000 button, a full sized map of Midgard will take up your screen.
scripts.translation: 點選地圖按鈕後，米德加爾特的完整地圖就會顯示在螢幕上。 ^006400^000000
